title: chat-server: sweep_expired destroys SpaceBans past expiresAt
description: Oracle draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §SpaceBan: "If present, the ban expires at this time and the server MUST restore the user's access." Compliance §9.2 (doc:609): run the expiry sweep, verify the ban is removed. Access checks already ignore expired bans (space.rs, federation deliver.rs); sweep_expired (expiry.rs) never destroys SpaceBans. Size S. From audit JMAP-x3lu (docs/audits/2026-11-19-x3lu/, jmap-chat-spec 120db2c).
